study.clock: T=S+lag; exit=T+h; exact adjusted open(T) to close(T+h)

references.title: Josse et al. (2024): On the consistency of supervised learning with missing values
Rockenschaub et al. (2024): Robust prediction under missingness shifts
Le Morvan et al. (2020): Linear predictor on linearly-generated data with missing values

simple_policy_forecast_diagnostics.basis: Original V1 forecasts on each simple policy selection, retained only as diagnostic; these policies do not generate return forecasts, so these fields are not baseline predictive accuracy or baseline expected return.

field_semantics.realized_direction_shares: positive_share and net_positive_share use actual realized returns of that policy; zero stays in resolved denominator, and missing outcomes are disclosed separately.
field_semantics.always_positive_accuracy: Accuracy of predicting positive on every resolved outcome; not a fitted model.
